draft_key_information_units.information: Full-year consolidated net turnover and net loss results with year-over-year comparison
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'For the 12 months of the 2024/2025 financial year, the Group’s unaudited consolidated turnover was EUR 26.11 million, a 4% decline from the previous financial year’s revenue.' and 'The consolidated unaudited result for the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year is a loss of EUR 820 thousand. The Group reported a loss of EUR 2.37 million for the 2023/2024 financial year.' Also from Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss.

draft_key_information_units.information: Q4 consolidated net turnover and net loss results with year-over-year comparison
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s unaudited consolidated net turnover for the fourth quarter (Q4) of the 2024/2025 financial year (FY) was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease compared to the same period in FY 2023/2024.' and 'The Group closed the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year with a loss of EUR 913 thousand (unaudited). In Q4 of the previous year, the Group recorded a loss of EUR 498 thousand.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Turnover breakdown by geographical region (Americas, Europe, Asia/Africa/Middle East) with percentage shares and year-over-year changes for both full year and Q4
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: detailed regional percentages and amounts, e.g. 'Over a 12-month period, revenues in North and Latin Americas represented 55% of the total turnover of the Group and amounted to EUR 14.28 million, thus showing a 14% decrease' and 'The turnover of the North America and Latin America region amounted to 47% or EUR 2.5 million. Compared to the same quarter of the previous financial year, the turnover has decreased by 40%.' with similar details for Europe and Asia/Africa/ME.

draft_key_information_units.information: Liquidity and cash position at period end including cash balance, net cash flow for the year, customer advances and available unused credit facility
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s net cash flow for the 12 months of the financial year is EUR 2.6 million. The Group’s cash balance in the balance sheet at the end of the period was EUR 4.8 million. Advances received from customers for goods totaled EUR 3.9 million. To ensure liquidity, the Parent Company has a Credit Line Agreement with Luminor Bank AS for a total amount of EUR 4.95 million, which had not been utilized at the end of the reporting period.' Also from Consolidated cash flow statement.

draft_key_information_units.information: Key performance drivers: impact of global electronic component shortages on inventory and delivery times; quarterly turnover fluctuations due to project completion timing, production duration and material procurement lead times
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s operations were affected by the global shortage of various electronic components. During the previous period, the company accumulated material reserves to be able to fulfill the majority of orders, ensuring short, or customer-expected, delivery times.' and 'As noted in previous reports, fluctuations in quarterly turnover are influenced by the completion of individual projects. Projects can vary in scope and complexity, and their execution is influenced by both the duration of the production process and the lead times for material procurement. As a result, the dispatch of goods and the recognition of revenue often take place only in subsequent quarters.'

draft_key_information_units.information: Q4 capital expenditures in fixed assets and continued investment in new product development, enhancements and sales promotion
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In Q4 of the 2024/2025 financial year, EUR 239 thousand were invested in the purchase of fixed assets – primarily to support production and testing processes, as well as for the acquisition of office equipment.' and 'The Group continues to invest in new product development and product enhancements, as well as in sales promotion across both existing and new market segments.' Also from Note 4.

draft_key_information_units.information: Market overview and external factors: no major changes in microwave radio market; monitoring of global trade environment including potential US tariffs; no direct impact from Ukraine conflict due to absence of clients/suppliers in affected regions; overall business uncertainty persists
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Market Overview and Guidelines: 'During the quarter, there were no major changes in the microwave radio market. ... The Group continuously monitors changes in the global trade environment, including potential tariff adjustments in the United States.' 'The Group has no clients or suppliers in the region affected by armed conflict (Russia, Ukraine, or Belarus); therefore, no impact on order volumes has been observed.' 'Although the hostilities in Ukraine do not directly impact the Group’s operations, overall uncertainty in the business environment persists.'

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units focus on headline financial performance (full year and Q4), major regional changes, liquidity/cash developments, and explicitly stated performance drivers as these are central to the report. Additional units address material operational investments and strategic/market context. Each unit represents a distinct, independently omittable theme to support concise summaries. Reference summary guided inclusion of Q4 metrics, regional details, cash/advances, project drivers, investments and geopolitical notes; full-year turnover was added from primary source as key material content.
